questions.question: Some of the cricket players are tennis players, some tennis players are hockey players, no cricket player is a hockey player. Which of the following diagrams correctly represents the above statements?
questions.questionHtml:
Some of the cricket players are tennis players, some tennis players are hockey players, no cricket player is a hockey player.

Which of the following diagrams correctly represents the above statements?
questions.solution:
Option (a): Cricket, Tennis, Hockey all overlap → Wrong (Cricket and Hockey must not overlap).

Option (b): Cricket is separate → Wrong (Cricket and Tennis must overlap).

Option (c): Cricket–Tennis overlap, Tennis–Hockey overlap, Cricket–Hockey no overlap → ✔️ Correct.

Option (d): One circle inside another → Wrong (no “all” type relation is given).

questions.question: Rohit is seventeenth from the left end of a row of 29 boys and Karan is seventeenth from the right end in the same row. How many boys are there between them in the row?
questions.questionHtml: Rohit is seventeenth from the left end of a row of 29 boys and Karan is seventeenth from the right end in the same row. How many boys are there between them in the row?
questions.solution:
Total boys = 29

Rohit’s position from left = 17

Karan’s position from right = 17 → From left = (29 – 17 + 1) = 13

Boys between them = (17 – 13 – 1) = 3

questions.question: Find the wrong number in the following series: 3, 9, 27, 81, 243, 729, 2188
questions.questionHtml:
Find the wrong number in the following series:

3, 9, 27, 81, 243, 729, 2188
questions.solution:
Solution:

The pattern of the series is multiplication by 3:
3 × 3 = 9
9 × 3 = 27
27 × 3 = 81
81 × 3 = 243
243 × 3 = 729
729 × 3 = 2187

So, the wrong number is 2188.
